title: Cyrus and the Portrait
author: Cyrus Brightwater
blurb: Xanthe Eriksen, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
